intended_object: The degree-n part of the change-of-coefficients map on normalized chains. For an additive homomorphism g : A → B, it is the map id ⊗ g : N_n(S;ℤ) ⊗_ℤ A → N_n(S;ℤ) ⊗_ℤ B, where N_n(S;ℤ) is the free abelian group on the nondegenerate n-simplices of S.
